_note: Curated, public-safe record of security findings and how they were closed. Add an entry whenever a finding is fixed or accepted. No secrets, hostnames or personal data.

entries.summary: pypdf 6.21.1: 10 CVEs with fixes in 6.21.2 to 6.21.4. First caught by the weekly scan; fixed by Dependabot PR #40, deployed the same day.
Base-image packages with Debian fixes available (libbrotli1 CRITICAL; openssl, apt HIGH). Cleared by rebuilding the image with --pull.
Scans were not required checks, and a failed scheduled scan notified nobody. Main now requires a PR plus pip-audit, Trivy and Checkov; failures open an alert issue.
A Checkov exception was documented as a cost decision but was a false positive (the WAF is attached; Checkov cannot follow the association). Reasons corrected.
Dockerfiles lacked HEALTHCHECK and USER (CKV_DOCKER_2/3). Both added.
pip and its vendored libraries flagged in the final image. pip removed from the runtime image.
trivy-action tags were hijacked in a public supply-chain compromise. The workflow is pinned to the known-clean release by full commit SHA; Dependabot is told not to move it.
Floating python:3.12-slim tag had drifted to a newer, largely unpatched Debian release. Pinned to the -bookworm base.
